subject.title: 2026.7.1 gateway crash-loop: legacy memory sidecar `meta`/`chunks` conflicts are fatal while `files` conflicts auto-resolve

question: Which divergent legacy Memory Core tables may Doctor automatically retire when canonical per-agent rows already exist: `meta` only, `meta` plus derived `embedding_cache`, or `chunks` as well?
rationale: Metadata, derived cache rows, and indexed content have different loss consequences; source inspection cannot determine the intended authority policy for conflicting persisted user state.

options.title: Use table-specific authority
options.body: Allow canonical-wins recovery for proven-stale metadata and derived cache identities, but require complete canonical coverage before retiring conflicting chunks.

options.title: Prefer canonical for all tables
options.body: Archive the whole legacy sidecar whenever canonical rows exist, accepting the risk that distinct legacy chunks may be discarded.

options.title: Keep all divergence fail-closed
options.body: Preserve the current strict policy but add an in-product Doctor recovery chooser with backup, comparison, and explicit operator confirmation.

recommendation.title: Use table-specific authority
recommendation.body: Allow canonical-wins recovery for proven-stale metadata and derived cache identities, but require complete canonical coverage before retiring conflicting chunks.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored and merged the current cross-migration convergence policy and is the strongest history-backed owner for defining its remaining conflict boundary.
